common.browseHint: or click to browse — JPEG · PNG · WebP · GIF · BMP · TIFF · ICO · SVG
common.tapBrowseHint: tap to browse — JPEG · PNG · WebP · BMP
common.canvasBrowseHint: or click to browse — JPEG · PNG · WebP · BMP
common.canvasTapHint: tap to browse — JPEG · PNG · WebP · BMP

home.heroTitle: Your images, local speed — AI when you need it.
home.heroSub: Everyday tools run free on this device. Hard problems — generation, cutouts, watermarks — go to the BrushLLM AI toolbox.
home.convertDesc: Batch-convert between 8 formats — in and out.
home.resizeDesc: By pixels, percentage or presets. Lanczos resampling.
home.compressDesc: Shrink files with quality presets and metadata stripping.
home.cropDesc: Aspect-ratio crop frames, 90° rotation, flips — live preview.
home.stitchDesc: Combine images into a long strip — vertical or horizontal.
home.watermarkDesc: Text or image watermark — tiled or positioned, rotate, opacity.
home.exifDesc: View, edit or strip metadata — dates, artist, GPS. Lossless.
home.roundedDesc: Round image corners — any radius, transparent or white fill.
home.pickerDesc: Sample colors from any pixel — HEX/RGB, one-click copy.
home.annotateDesc: Mark up images — shapes, arrows, highlights and text notes.
home.generateDesc: Create a brand-new image from a text prompt.
home.removeBgDesc: Clean background removal via AI regeneration.
home.cutoutDesc: Isolate the subject on a transparent background.
home.removeWmDesc: Paint over watermarks — AI rebuilds the pixels.
home.removeObjDesc: Erase objects and reconstruct the background.
home.fillDesc: Fill masked areas with generated content.
home.restyleDesc: Transform the whole image into a new style.
home.mosaicDesc: Pixelate any area you paint — faces, plates, text.
home.shadowDesc: Drop shadow with offset, blur, color and opacity.
home.recolorDesc: Swap a color while keeping shadows and texture.
home.mirrorDesc: Join an image with its reflection — A | A.

convert.title: Convert Format
convert.subtitle: Convert any of 8 input formats into 8 output formats. Runs entirely on your machine — free and private.
convert.originalHint: Keeps the input format where possible — SVG and ICO keep theirs; GIF is saved as PNG.
convert.firstOfMany: Preview shows the first of {{count}} images.
convert.hintWebp: WebP output is lossless (quality does not apply).
convert.hintAvif: Higher = better quality, larger files. 50–70 usually best for photos.
convert.hintSvg: Lossless — pixels are embedded in an SVG wrapper (not vector tracing).
convert.hintIco: ICO stores a lossless PNG frame (Windows icon format).
convert.gifHint: GIF inputs are processed as their first frame and saved as PNG.

compress.title: Compress
compress.subtitle: Shrink file size with quality control and metadata stripping. Runs locally — free and private.
compress.tip: Tip: AVIF at quality 50–70 usually gives the smallest photos. Metadata is stripped unless you keep EXIF.
compress.firstOfMany: Preview shows the first of {{count}} images.

resize.title: Resize
resize.subtitle: Scale images by pixels, percentage or preset. Lanczos resampling, runs locally — free and private.
resize.aspectHint: Each image keeps its aspect ratio.
resize.lockAspect: Lock aspect ratio (leave one field empty to auto-fit)
resize.firstOfMany: Preview shows the first of {{count}} images.

crop.title: Crop & Rotate
crop.subtitle: Drag the crop frame, pick an aspect ratio, rotate or flip — the preview always matches the output. Runs locally — free and private.

stitch.title: Stitch Images
stitch.subtitle: Combine multiple images into one long image — vertically or horizontally, with spacing and alignment. Runs locally — free and private.
stitch.dropLabel: Drop images to stitch (add in order)
stitch.normalizeHint: All images are scaled to this size first (aspect ratio kept).
stitch.exactPreview: Exact preview — stitched with the engine at current settings.
stitch.firstTen: Preview uses the first 10 images; the real output stitches all of them.

watermark.title: Watermark
watermark.subtitle: Text or image watermark — tiled or positioned, with rotation and opacity. Live preview, runs locally — free and private.

exif.title: EXIF Metadata
exif.subtitle: Inspect, edit or strip photo metadata — dates, author, copyright, GPS. JPEG is rewritten losslessly (no quality loss). Runs locally.
exif.noExif: No EXIF metadata found in this file.
exif.dropHint: EXIF lives in JPEG and TIFF files.
exif.stripGpsHint: Removes GPS tags, keeps everything else. JPEG and PNG.

rounded.title: Rounded Corners
rounded.subtitle: Round the corners of an image with a live preview. PNG keeps the corners transparent; JPEG fills them with white. Runs locally — free and private.
rounded.radiusHint: Percentage of the shorter image side; 50% turns squares into circles.

picker.title: Color Picker
picker.subtitle: Hover to inspect any pixel, click to sample it. HEX and RGB values copy with one click. Runs locally — free and private.
picker.samplesHint: Click colors on the image to collect them here.
picker.hoverHint: Hover to inspect · click to sample a color.

annotate.title: Annotate
annotate.subtitle: Mark up an image with rectangles, ellipses, lines, arrows, highlights and text notes — then export a PNG. Runs locally — free and private.
annotate.textPlaceholder: Type the note, then click the image
annotate.dragHint: Drag on the image to draw the selected shape.
annotate.textHint: Click to place the text “{{text}}” — edit it on the right.

ai.title: AI Toolbox
ai.subtitle: Generate brand-new images, or paint over the problem area and let BrushLLM's image models regenerate it. Cloud-powered, billed per image.
ai.promptPrefilled: Prompt (prefilled by the tool — edit freely)
ai.promptPlaceholderGen: A brush painting of a mountain lake at sunrise…
ai.promptPlaceholderEdit: Describe what the AI should do…
ai.modelHint: {{model}} — configured in Settings · Default image model.
ai.editsSizesHint: Image edits accept the three official tiers; 2K/4K and custom sizes are text-to-image only.
ai.customRules: Both sides multiples of 16 · longest side ≤ 3840 · ratio ≤ 3:1 · 0.65–8.3 MP.
ai.customMult16: Both sides must be multiples of 16.
ai.customMax: The longest side must be 3840px or less.
ai.customPixels: Total pixels must be between 655,360 and 8,294,400.
ai.countHint: Batch generation is not available on this backend yet.
ai.dropHint: or click to browse — JPEG · PNG
ai.maskTools: Mask tools — mark the area for the AI to redraw.
ai.maskHint: Paint over the area for {{tool}} — or leave the mask empty to let the AI work on the whole image.
ai.maskNoNeed: {{tool}} works on the whole image — no mask needed. Paint one only if you want to restrict the area.
ai.sendToHint: The result becomes that tool's source image — continue editing without re-dropping.
ai.generatingHint: The model is redrawing the image — this usually takes 10–30 seconds.
ai.refHint: Add 1–3 reference images (e.g. a person to swap in). Multi-image works with gpt-image models only; leave empty for single-image behavior.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Your API key lives in the OS keychain (macOS Keychain / Windows Credential Manager), never in a plain file.
settings.keyStoredHint: Stored in your OS keychain — leave empty to keep it.
settings.keyCreateHint: Create one in the BrushLLM console to use AI tools.
settings.modelTestHint: Test the connection to list the models your gateway serves — the default model is picked from that list.
settings.modelOneHint: One model only; change it any time by re-testing and picking another.
settings.connected: Connected — image edits: {{edits}} models · text-to-image: {{t2i}} models
settings.missingModel: Default image model (pick from the tested list)
settings.themeHint: System follows your OS appearance — dark mode included.
settings.folderHint: All tools use this folder by default (you can still override per run). Originals are never overwritten — name collisions get " (2)", " (3)"… suffixes automatically.
settings.localHint: Always on this device. Convert, resize, compress and crop never make a network request and never upload your images.
settings.aiHint: The app only connects to BrushLLM when you explicitly run an AI tool. The image, optional mask and prompt are sent to the API and billed per image.
settings.telemetryHint: None. No analytics, no trackers, no ads, no crash reports.
settings.aboutText: BrushLLM Image Studio — local-first image toolbox.
settings.aboutLocal: Local tools (convert, resize, compress, crop, stitch, watermark, EXIF) run 100% on this device: free, offline, private. AI tools send the selected image, optional mask and your prompt to the BrushLLM API and are billed per image at your plan's rates.

errors.unsupported: {{what}} not supported by this tool — it only accepts {{formats}}. Convert to JPEG or PNG first (the Convert Format tool can help).
errors.unsupportedOne: This file is not supported by this tool — it only accepts {{formats}}. Convert to JPEG or PNG first (the Convert Format tool can help).
errors.blocked: {{what}} can't be read yet — {{list}} input is not supported by this app.
errors.blockedOne: This file can't be read yet — {{list}} input is not supported by this app.
errors.noKey: no API key configured — add one in Settings first

adjust.title: Adjust
adjust.subtitle: Brightness, contrast and saturation — with a live preview and batch support. Runs on your machine — free and private.
adjust.firstOfMany: Preview shows the first of {{count}} images.

mosaic.title: Mosaic
mosaic.subtitle: Paint over faces, plates or text to pixelate them — block size adjustable. Runs locally — free and private.
mosaic.blockHint: Larger blocks hide more; smaller blocks keep more detail.
mosaic.hint: Paint the areas to pixelate; the purple overlay marks the selection.

shadow.title: Shadow
shadow.subtitle: Add a drop shadow — offset, blur, color and opacity, with the canvas auto-expanded. Runs locally — free and private.
shadow.canvasNote: The output PNG grows around the image to fit the shadow (transparent background).

recolor.title: Color Replace
recolor.subtitle: Pick a color on the image, choose the new color — shadows, highlights and texture are preserved. Runs locally — free and private.
recolor.toleranceHint: Higher replaces more similar shades; the blend is smooth — no hard edges.
recolor.hint: Click the image to pick the color to replace.
recolor.pairHint: Click the image to pick a source color, then choose its replacement. Add up to 6 pairs.

mirror.title: Mirror
mirror.subtitle: Join the image with its own reflection — A | A side by side or top to bottom. Batch-capable, runs on your machine — free and private.
mirror.firstOfMany: Preview shows the first of {{count}} images.
